jen_marketing: quick ask for the webinar/launch materials: can runtime run a focused benchmark (hosted vs dedicated) and drop a reproducible CSV + short JSON summary in S3? we need defensible numbers marketing can quote.

sam_marketing: metrics: p50/p90/p99 token latency, tokens/sec at 10/50/200 QPS, cost/1k tokens (current reserved pricing), plus 6 sample outputs for human QA. mark cold vs warmed.

rick_marketing: timeline: smoke today, full run by Thu morning. headline needs a recommended metric to use and a conservative fallback.

lia_eng_runtime: we can run. propose models: amy-small.fp16, amy-base.int8, amy-large.fp16. seq lengths: 512 interactive, 1024 batch. warmed = after 50 warmups. we'll save raw logs and produce results.csv with fields: run_id,model,quant,hw,batch,seq,qps,p50_ms,p90_ms,p99_ms,tokens_per_sec,cost_per_1k.

noah_runtime: will include hardware, CUDA/cuDNN, kernel flags. hosted runs go via marketing-bench SA (no keys in logs). sample command: ./bench_runner --model $MODEL --seq 512 --qps 50 --samples 1000 --warmups 50 --out s3://redwood-marketing/bench-1772709999/$MODEL.csv

benchbot: scheduled job webinar_1772709999-smoke on g5.allocated-2 at 2026-03-23T14:35:00Z

lia_eng_runtime: starting smoke in ~10m. will ping with S3 link and a one-line summary for the deck when smoke completes.

jen_marketing: awesome, thanks! please flag top-3 failure modes and any p99 outliers in the summary.
